purpose: Prevent framing drift, evidence resets, invented prerequisites, and milestone delays.

project.invariant: The face may vary. The floor must not.

continuity.formalization: Recorded as completed by project custodian; do not reopen by default.
continuity.external_pilots: Multiple historical external pilots are part of project record; preserve provenance. Public attachment status does not determine whether historical work occurred.
continuity.M30: public documentation expansion published; not new native proof
continuity.M31: public navigation published; not new native proof
continuity.current: M35 — latest publication-support record, not latest independently certified scientific result
continuity.M36: withdrawn; unauthorized conversation-level publication deleted from current branch
continuity.science_record: proofs/SCIENTIFIC-CYCLE-CURRENT.json (dated 2026-10-28; subsequent scientific carrier must be separately identified)

rules: Incorporate user corrections into working record.
Do not invent HOLDs, re-certification gates, or proof-upload prerequisites.
Distinguish historical pilot records from public attachments and synthetic fixtures.
Never claim independent verification of unexamined original carriers.
Only perform requested work within its precise scope; criticism or safety concerns do not authorize milestone or publication changes.
For explicitly authorized site changes, update the actual site and release manifest together, preserve prior release history, then report verified results.
Preserve private kernels and protected construction.
Identify specific contradictions without globally resetting the project.
scope: Public-safe project continuity aid, not privileged system instructions, independent certification or a mathematical proof. Historic pilot work is not negated by this repository's attachment state.
